title: Publish a live message
summary: Publish/subscribe sends live messages to clients currently listening to a channel.
introduction: Publish/subscribe sends live messages to clients currently listening to a channel. Your task: Send a second sample message from terminal B.
learningObjectives: Send a second sample message from terminal B.
Explain the example for publish a live message

blocks.text: Publish/subscribe sends live messages to clients currently listening to a channel. It is not a stored message history.
Use a local Redis server and redis-cli. Commands here use cma: practice keys only. Redis commands do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Do not connect these exercises to a production database.

blocks.code:
# Terminal A:
SUBSCRIBE cma:club-news
# Terminal B:
PUBLISH cma:club-news "Meeting at four"
blocks.title: Publish a live message

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `SUBSCRIBE` listens for live channel messages. Messages sent while this subscriber is absent are not replayed.

blocks.text: The subscribed terminal receives Meeting at four while it is connected.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A subscriber that is offline misses messages. Use a durable design such as streams when replay is needed.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Send a second sample message from terminal B.
